## Plan

1. `hh-ledger::wakeup::deliver_wakeup` gains the producer pass (before
   `wakeup_due` synthesis): a `control.retry.scheduled` row with no live
   `retry_due` subscription mints one (the durable timer produces the
   durable subscription — CC1 with the fleet reconciler's machinery);
   a `fired` occurrence withheld by `deliver_after` mints an
   `effect_terminal` subscription so the run re-cues when the blocking
   effect folds terminal.
2. `hh-embed` boundary ops — `suspend`, `compensate`, `heal` — through
   the single `hh-embed/1` dispatch: writer-session + writer-lease only,
   durable rows first, typed refusals (`OpenCommittedEffects`,
   `session_is_read_only`, `healing_policy_ref` resolution failures).
3. `healing_policy_ref` resolves through the one `RegistryStore` —
   `{top-level|semantic}.healing_policy` member on the named record;
   inline `policy` and `policy_ref` param legs; attendance default only
   when no ref is declared.
4. `connection_info{on_loss}` (Stage-2 declared posture; the Stage-1
   `fail_run` default is preserved) and `healing_policy_ref` stamping
   onto the run manifest.
5. Tests (`tests/r2_3_execution_legs.rs`), DEFERRALS/BL flips,
   BUILD_INDEX 106, LEDGER → R2.4.

## Results

1. **Producer legs** (`crates/hh-ledger/src/wakeup.rs`) —
   `Store::deliver_wakeup` opens with `wakeup_producers`: every
   `control.retry.scheduled{scope_id}` row mints one live `retry_due`
   subscription per scope (`created_by` = the scheduled row); a `fired`
   occurrence still withheld by `deliver_after` mints the
   `effect_terminal` subscription for the blocking committed effect
   (`created_by` = the `fired` row). Live-cover dedup — a cancelled or
   expired sub is replaced, a live one is reused. The pass reads durable
   state only, so a same-call withheld fire lands its leg on the next
   pass (durable-before-visible; KP-11 restart discipline unchanged).
   The non-fleet `timer` leg lands at the pending-permission seam —
   a deadline-bearing `pending` mints `Trigger::Timer{at_ms: deadline}`
   durable before any occurrence it synthesizes
   (`crates/hh-embed/src/service.rs`).

2. **`suspend`** (`hh-embed::durability_ops::run_suspend`) —
   writer-session + writer-lease only; `reasons` decode into
   `SuspendReason` with producing subscriptions minted
   (`awaiting_approval → PermissionDecided`, `awaiting_timer → Timer`,
   `awaiting_child → ChildTerminal`, `awaiting_effect → EffectTerminal`
   validated against the effect fold, `awaiting_event` naming an
   existing subscription) durable before `lifecycle.run.suspended`;
   S-1 pre-checked (`prepared`/`deferred`/`committed` ⇒
   `OpenCommittedEffects`) before any producer mints; explicit
   `subscription_ids` must resolve (`Refused` on a miss); `release_lease`
   defaults true and detaches the session (`detached:"suspended"`).

3. **`compensate`** (`run_compensate`) — reverse commit-order walk of
   applied, compensable effects under the writer lease; the host's
   declared `outcomes{effect_id: payload | {"error": reason}}` is the
   dispatch; a missing entry is the honest `CompensatorMissing` leg —
   `abandoned` + `lifecycle.escalation.raised`, never a fabricated
   `observed`; `after_seq` scopes the walk; the response reports the
   saga's own sums.

4. **`heal`** (`run_heal`) — the live verdict is measured
   (`verify_environment_verdict`); `attached` ⇒ `Refused`; a
   non-attached `ready` handle is marked `unreachable` durable before
   `heal_with_policy` runs the ladder — `healed`/`ask`/`refused`
   verbatim, handle id never returned (R-NOSIDE). On a successor handle
   the session rebinds `env_handle_id`.

5. **`healing_policy_ref`** — `connection_info{healing_policy_ref}`
   stamps `manifest.healing_policy_ref` at open (`open.rs`);
   `healing_policy_for` resolves inline `policy` > `policy_ref` >
   manifest ref > attendance default (`interactive → ask`, else
   `reprovision`, max_heals 3) through the one `RegistryStore`;
   unresolvable/policy-free/malformed declared refs are typed `Refused`
   — `HealingPolicy::to_json`/`from_json` is the one codec
   (`crates/hh-env/src/recovery.rs`).

6. **`connection_info{on_loss}`** decodes the declared loss posture at
   open — `fail_run` default preserved verbatim;
   `replace_from_image`/`replace_from_snapshot` open the ladder's
   replace rung; an unknown spelling is a typed `EnvironmentUnavailable`
   at open.

7. **Schema + dispatch** — `suspend`/`compensate`/`heal` registered in
   `hh-embed-schema` (`SuspendParams`/`CompensateParams`/`HealParams`
   typed params; `Tier::Experimental`, writer group); dispatch routed
   through `EmbedService::handle`; artifacts regenerated via
   `scripts/check-drift.sh` (CC7) — `hh-embed-1.schema.json`,
   `compat-1.matrix.json`, `hh-embed-client-generated/src/generated.rs`.
